terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: Read the essential rules for using eduAssets safely and responsibly.
terms.acceptance_text: By accessing or using eduAssets, you confirm that you have read these Terms of Use and agree to the rules described here. If you do not agree, do not use the protected areas of the system.
terms.purpose_text: eduAssets is a portfolio project demonstrating a solution for organizing inventory, loans, returns, and incidents. Although it may be adopted by an institution, it is not currently an institutional daily-use service.
terms.access_text: Each person must use only their own credentials, keep their password confidential, and report any suspected unauthorized access to the system administrator.
terms.guest_text: Guest mode provides read-only access. Personal data and change actions may be hidden or blocked until an authorized session is started.
terms.responsibility_text: Users are responsible for the data they enter, the actions performed through their account, and the purpose for which they use the system. Institutional use, adoption, redistribution, code changes, or derivative projects must be requested and authorized in advance by the project owner. Selling, reselling, or commercially offering the eduAssets ecosystem, in its original or modified form, is prohibited without express authorization.
terms.use_text: When using eduAssets, users must act responsibly and remain within their granted permissions. The following is not allowed:
terms.use_item_auth: Attempting to bypass authentication mechanisms, permissions, or security controls.
terms.use_item_records: Intentionally entering, changing, or deleting records improperly or fraudulently.
terms.use_item_credentials: Sharing credentials or misusing another person's account.
terms.use_item_exploit: Exploiting vulnerabilities, interfering with operation, or accessing information without authorization.
terms.use_item_illegal: Using the system for unlawful activities or to harm its operation, users, or an institution.
terms.use_followup: Failures, inconsistencies, or unexpected behavior should be reported to the system administrator without attempting to exploit them.
terms.integrity_text: Users must record accurate information consistent with the activities performed. Errors, discrepancies, or duplicate records should be reported to the system administrator. Displayed information depends on the records maintained and should be verified when necessary.
terms.availability_text: eduAssets may be temporarily unavailable because of maintenance, updates, security measures, technical failures, or issues with dependent services. Continuous availability or complete absence of failures cannot be guaranteed.
terms.privacy_text: Information accessed must be used only for authorized purposes, respecting data confidentiality and applicable rules. How eduAssets processes personal data is described in the Privacy Policy, available on the entry screen.
terms.changes_text: These Terms of Use may be revised to reflect changes to eduAssets features, usage procedures, or applicable requirements. The current version will remain available on this screen and will take effect upon publication unless another effective date is stated.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How eduAssets handles personal data at app.eduassets.tech, under the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD, Law 13,709/2018).
privacy.footer_note: Questions or requests about your data:
consent.title: Statistics cookies
consent.text: We use essential cookies for the session and preferences. With your consent, we also use Google Analytics to understand how eduAssets is used, in aggregate.
privacy.controller_text: eduAssets is a portfolio project maintained by Thiago da Silva, who is responsible (controller) for the personal data processed in this installation: the app at app.eduassets.tech and the API at api.eduassets.tech. The privacy contact is the email shown at the bottom of this screen. An institution that adopts eduAssets in its own installation becomes responsible for the data of that installation.
privacy.data_text: The system processes only the data needed to manage loans, inventory and incidents:
privacy.accounts: User accounts: name, email used as login, access level, status (active or inactive), creation and change dates and who made them. The password is stored only as a bcrypt hash; an RFID card, when registered, is stored only as a hash.
privacy.records: Operational records: the name of who took each loan, the person in charge (name and role), dates, items and notes; equipment incidents with description, problem and actions taken. These fields are filled in by users: record only what is needed and avoid personal data in free-text fields.
privacy.audit: Audit trail: which account made which change, to which record, which fields changed and when — without copying the values.
privacy.recovery: Password recovery: a single-use code, stored only as a hash, valid for 30 minutes.
privacy.technical: Technical data: IP address, method, path (without sensitive parameters), response code and timing of each API request, in logs where emails and tokens are masked; temporary attempt counters, kept in memory, to limit abuse.
privacy.push_data: Push notifications (optional, administrators only): the technical address and encryption keys of the subscription made in the browser, the linked account and the chosen options. The notification shows the requester name (for loans and returns), a summary of equipment, the occurrence type and the name of who registered the operation, without notes, descriptions or asset numbers. It may appear on the device lock screen.
privacy.guest_text: Without signing in, guest mode shows only information without personal data: loans appear without borrower, person in charge and notes, and incidents without asset number, problem, description and actions. People in charge and users are visible only in an authorized session.
privacy.purpose_service: Running accounts, authentication and recording loans, returns and incidents: performing the features requested (LGPD art. 7, V).
privacy.purpose_security: Security, audit trail, logs, rate limits and backups: legitimate interest in protecting the system and its users (art. 7, IX).
privacy.purpose_analytics: Usage statistics with Google Analytics: consent, which can be refused or withdrawn at any time (art. 7, I).
privacy.purpose_push: Optional push notifications for administrators: consent, given when you turn the feature on in the browser and revocable at any time (art. 7, I).
privacy.providers_title: 5. Who the data is shared with
privacy.providers_text: eduAssets does not sell personal data. To run, it uses the providers below, which process data on the project's behalf; some of them may process it outside Brazil:
privacy.cloudflare: Cloudflare: DNS, traffic protection and encryption, app hosting and aggregate access and performance metrics (Cloudflare Web Analytics, cookieless).
privacy.oracle: Oracle Cloud: the server that runs the API.
privacy.r2: Cloudflare R2: database backups, encrypted before upload.
privacy.brevo: Brevo: sending the password recovery email (name, email and link). Brevo records delivery, opens and clicks for that email.
privacy.zoho: Zoho Mail: receiving messages sent to @eduassets.tech addresses, such as support.
privacy.github: GitHub: hosts the code and guides; the app's documentation center downloads the guides from raw.githubusercontent.com.
privacy.push: Browser push services (Google, Apple, Mozilla and Microsoft, depending on the browser used): deliver the optional administrator notifications to the device. They receive the technical address of the subscription and an encrypted message they cannot read.
privacy.google: Google Analytics: only if you accept statistics cookies (section 7).
privacy.ret_records: Accounts, operational records and audit trail: while this installation is in operation. Accounts are not deleted through the interface; an administrator can deactivate them, which blocks access.
privacy.ret_session: Session: up to 8 hours after sign-in, or until you sign out.
privacy.ret_recovery: Recovery codes: valid for 30 minutes and a single use. A new request deletes the account’s previous codes, a reset deletes the other codes and marks the used one as used, and codes expired for more than 24 hours are deleted on the next request.
privacy.ret_logs: API logs: size-based rotation, at most 5 files of 10 MB.
privacy.ret_backups: Encrypted backups: 7 days on the server and 30 days in Cloudflare R2.
privacy.ret_analytics: Google Analytics: cookies for up to 2 years in your browser; events are kept for the retention period configured in the Google Analytics property.
privacy.ret_push: Notification subscriptions: until the administrator turns the feature off, signs out on the device or changes the password. Subscriptions refused by the push service are also deleted, and deactivated or demoted accounts stop receiving immediately.
privacy.ck_session: Essential — __Host-eduassets_session: protected session cookie (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax), valid for up to 8 hours.
privacy.ck_local: Essential — browser storage: eduassets_theme and eduassets_lang (theme and language), eduassets_logout_pendente (completes a sign-out made offline), eduassets_guest_entry_authorized (guest mode in the current tab), eduassets_analytics_consent (your statistics choice), eduassets_alert_sound (alert sound) and eduassets_push_prefs (notification options for this device).
privacy.ck_ga: Statistics, only with consent — _ga and _ga_9LJ1MQRCEV: Google Analytics cookies that count visits and pages in aggregate. Google signals and ad personalization are turned off, and the password recovery link is never sent.
privacy.ck_push: Essential to the feature, only if turned on — service worker and notification subscription: the browser keeps this device subscription until you turn it off; the service worker stores no data or copies of the app.
privacy.cookies_text: Without your consent, no Google script is loaded. You can change your choice at any time with the Cookie preferences button below; refusing deletes the Google Analytics cookies.
privacy.security_text: Traffic uses HTTPS; passwords, RFID cards and recovery codes are stored only as hashes; the session uses a protected cookie; access is controlled by level (administrator or editor) and changes are audited; logs mask emails and tokens; backups are encrypted before leaving the server.
privacy.rights_text: You can request confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary data, portability, information about sharing and withdrawal of consent (LGPD art. 18) through the email below. You may also file a complaint with the Brazilian Data Protection Authority (ANPD).
privacy.changes_text: This policy may be revised when eduAssets changes how it handles data. The current version is available on this screen, with the date of the last update. If the purposes of the statistics change, your cookie choice will be asked again.
